summary: Local headless MCP static 3D v0.1 installed and accepted on the owner's Windows PC. Actual MCP-to-Blender generation, image delivery, GLB readback and a separate static V4 render passed. Independent Reviewer returned ACCEPT; human artistic approval remains separate.
decisions: Use the official MCP SDK stdio transport and a local Blender worker; no Oriverse runtime dependency.
Use explicit khosan.scene/1.0 and a documented small KHOSAN Weave dialect; unsupported features fail.
Retain semantic object and editable part identity; separate technical checks, independent review and human acceptance.
Keep current source status and separately verified V4 static rendering as distinct evidence. Preserve historical pre-review snapshots.
Tool Registry adoption applies only to local static v0.1. No remote Git changes, global client configuration rewrite or episode migration.

known_risks: Acceptance is limited to five bounded static procedural recipe families and one authored fixture, not a complete Oriverse feature replacement.
Arbitrary image reconstruction, character rigging, skinning, animation, cloth, mocap and physics remain unsupported.

V4 evidence is a separate static composition using installed dependencies; no original Stage/episode migration, video, continuous playback, same-page seek, every-frame validation or Blender-look parity is claimed.
Independent agent review is not human artistic approval; human_acceptance remains NOT_REVIEWED and production_ready remains false.
No local vision model is bundled. Reviewer identity is supplied by the trusted local client and is not cryptographically authenticated.
Normal owned-process cancellation/timeout was verified; abrupt parent-process kill recovery and durable Blender job resumption remain unimplemented.
Cold 11.578 s and verified warm 0.031 s are measurements for this fixture on this PC; the warm result reuses artifacts. No comparative superiority against Oriverse was tested.
Windows symlink-escape test is skipped because the environment lacks symlink privilege; the same test passes in Linux.
The current dependencies emit nonfatal Pydantic lifespan and Three.Clock deprecation warnings; actual MCP calls and V4 rendering succeed.
The Studio baseline is a verified 155-file GitHub source snapshot, not a Git checkout. New local changes have not been committed, pushed or merged.
Local stdio client configuration is provided and actual SDK calls were tested. This does not register new tools automatically in every ChatGPT Web conversation.
Studio v0.2 browser acceptance, Docker deployment and external rigging GPU acceptance remain separate pending work.
next_action: Use the registered local stdio command or proof launcher for new static scene jobs. The next development slice should add representative scene recipes and measured V4 lighting/look matching; use reference review for each new asset. Character/rigging fixtures and original episode integration require separate bounded tasks. Preserve existing Studio browser-acceptance backlog.
